changes.comment: Fix intermittent folder-deletion failures for Windows users of `FileSystem.deleteFolder`, `FileSystem.deleteFolderAsync`, `FileSystem.ensureEmptyFolder`, and `FileSystem.ensureEmptyFolderAsync` when another process briefly holds a file open.

`FileSystem.ensureEmptyFolderAsync` now limits deletion to 10 concurrent top-level entries. Both folder-emptying methods now throw on read errors other than `ENOENT` instead of silently leaving an unreadable folder unemptied.
